fullContentHtml:
NTA UGC NET June Certificate 2026 – Full Details

National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the Certificate for the University Grant Commission UGC National Eligibility Test NET Assistant Professor / JRF June 2026 examination. Applications for the NTA UGC NET June Online Form 2026 were accepted from 29 April 2026, to 24 May 2026. The re-examination was held on 07 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this re-examination can download their NTA UGC NET June Certificate 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 April 2026
  • Last Date : 24 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 May 2026
  • Correction Date : 26-28 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 22-30 June 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 June 2026
  • Admit Card : 17 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 August 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 28 August 2026
  • Result : 28 August 2026
  • Re-Exam Date : 09-10 September 2026
  • Re-Exam City Details : 01 September 2026
  • Re-Exam Admit Card : 04 September 2026
  • Re-Exam Answer Key : 10 September 2026
  • Re-Exam Final Answer Key : 17 September 2026
  • Re-Exam Result : 18 September 2026
  • Certificate : 24 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General : Rs. 1150/-
  • EWS, OBC : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 325/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

NTA UGC NET June Certificate 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.
